arrival.speaker: Keeper Ming
arrival.say: You have reached Treehouse Summit. The Great Dictionary Tree once sheltered every Word Spirit, but its heart has gone quiet.

arrival.speaker: Keeper Ming
arrival.say: Your Brush Fragments have carried memories from every region. Find the final spirits, restore the Treeheart Lens, and face the Great Forgetter.

arrival.speaker: Keeper Ming
arrival.say: The words you saved belong to everyone. Let us bring them home together.

reform.speaker: Great Forgetter
reform.say: If no one remembers a word, I thought no one could disagree, make mistakes, or be hurt.

reform.speaker: Keeper Ming
reform.say: A forgotten word also takes away a story, a promise, and a way to help someone.

reform.speaker: Hero
reform.say: We can make mistakes, learn again, and still keep our promises.

reform.speaker: Great Forgetter
reform.say: Then let the words return. I will remember what I nearly erased.

reform.speaker: Spirit Brush
reform.say: Final Stroke restored. The Brush is whole, and the Great Dictionary Tree can bloom again.
